# Custom instructions for GitHub Copilot in the **s3-log-extraction** repository

All agent instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), at the repository root.

Read that file and follow it. Do not add rules here: this file exists only so that tooling which looks for
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` by path is pointed at the single source of truth, and any rule written here
would drift out of step with it.
